'''Huaiming''' is an [[NPC]] professor who appears both during 12:00-17:59 at the Faculty Office and during the day at the {{Location|Teaching Zone}}.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Huaiming:''' Your thesis paper is... academically hopeless.
:'''Huaiming:''' But don't lose hope! It might find an audience somewhere else.

==Dialogue==
:'''Huaiming:''' Massi! I haven't seen eye to eye with that geezer in years. Alright, listen to me, delete my name from your thesis paper. Put him down as your advisor instead.
:'''Huaiming:''' I'll find some way to discredit him. The faculty will have to strike his name from all academic works, and you'll get sole authorship! How's that sound?
:'''Rayla:''' Professor, I'm stressing out here, and you're making jokes. Please give some actual feedback. I'm counting on this paper to graduate.
:'''Huaiming:''' Actual... feedback, alright. Change this, this, this, and everything else.
:'''Rayla:''' You want me to start from scratch and write a new one? The work that involves—Impossible...
{{Dialogue End}}
